name: Tarsevi Döküm Sanayi A.Ş.

standard_terms_hint.skonto: offers a cash discount for payment within 10 days (amount not stated)

quality.trend: red four quarters running, OTD falling (80 % 2025Q1 -> 52 %)

payment_behaviour.note: avg 64.9 days on 60 net; 6.2 days late in last 12m

financial_health.signal: bank restructuring after two loss-making years; idle capacity

situation: Turkish family foundry with idle capacity: half the floor idle, second shift on hold since spring, short hours. It is restructuring with its banks and asking to be paid in 10 days. It is the cheapest HB 40 housing source (32.24 vs Pfaffenreuth 43.39; German-base should-cost 39.82, about 30 at a TR cost base), but red on delivery and quality with a 70-day lead time. The owner offers to walk us through his calculation. It bids for HX 80-200 (P06) and will price aggressively for volume.

pressures.evidence: asks for 10-day payment; MD says bank watches every month
half shop floor idle, second shift on hold

what_it_values: volume to restart the second shift (HX work, more HB 40 quota)
being seen as a transparent partner (open book)

likely_tradeables.get: price held or reduced; OTD commitment
likely_tradeables.why: cash-short; trading price for cash does not squeeze it

likely_tradeables.give: more HB 40 quota or HX award
likely_tradeables.get: lower unit price and binding ppm/OTD commitment

likely_tradeables.why: 70 days is the longest of our iron foundries

arguments_that_should_land.argument: Take up the owner's open-book offer: walk through hourly rates and material together.
arguments_that_should_land.why: his own offer; lets us see the floor

arguments_that_should_land.argument: Euro is up 15.5 % against the lira in 12 months (48.49 -> 56.01 TRY per EUR), easing lira-based costs.
arguments_that_should_land.why: counters any cost-increase plea (use moderately: TR inflation is high)

arguments_that_should_land.argument: HB 40 forecast 26,400 pc, +2.5 %: volume we can commit.

arguments_to_avoid.argument: Price cut without a cash or volume give
arguments_to_avoid.why: MD: 'I cannot sign anything that lowers our margin now'

arguments_to_avoid.argument: Big volume shift with no quality conditions
arguments_to_avoid.why: OTD 52 %, red four quarters - volume must come with ppm/OTD commitments
it is a German-base estimate (12 % error); TR cost is ~25 % lower, so it would argue for a higher price

key_quotes.quote: they could take additional parts at short notice; the second shift has been on hold since spring
he offered to walk us through their calculation
